I have farmed in Oromia for many years and know this rented plot well. I will get DAP and urea from the cooperative as usual, though the supply is never enough, and I will also spread manure from my cattle because the soil needs strength. I will sow seed I kept from my own harvest since improved seed is costly and hard to find, and I do not use pesticide on this crop. My family will do most of the work, but I will hire some extra hands from the village when it is time to weed and harvest because I must tend my other plots too.
